Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the biographical information and stated that Antonio Vivaldi’s birthplace was Vienna (confusing it with his place of death). This led the plan toward identifying a Vienna bridge (Reichsbrücke) instead of the correct famous bridge in his actual birthplace, Venice (Rialto Bridge).
